source_text:
Μιμησώμεθα τοῦ ἀνδροφόνου τὴν ἀγαθὴν γνώμην, μᾶλλον δὲ τοῦ πνευματοφόρου
διὰ τὴν μετὰ ταῦτα πίστιν. Τί γὰρ καί φησιν; – «Μνήσθητί μου, κύριε, ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ
σου.» Καὶ ἐν μιᾷ συγκαταθέσει πίστεως παράδεισον οἰκεῖ καὶ οὐρανοὺς περιπολεῖ.
«Ἀμὴν γὰρ λέγω σοι, φησίν, σήμερον μετ' ἐμοῦ ἔσῃ ἐν τῷ παραδείσῳ.»
Παραμείνωμεν καὶ ἡμεῖς τῷ τοῦ σωτῆρος σταυρῷ, λέγοντες αὐτὰς τὰς φωνάς·
«Κύριε, μνήσθητί μου ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ σου», ἵνα καὶ ἡμεῖς τοῦ παραδείσου μέτοχοι
γενώμεθα καὶ βασιλείας οὐρανῶν ἀπολαύσωμεν.
5 Νικητήριον ἡ παροῦσα πανήγυρις, ἀδελφοί, νικητήριον τοῦ παμβασιλέως
υἱοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ. Σήμερον γὰρ ὁ διάβολος διὰ τὸν σταυρωθέντα ἡττήθη, τὸ δὲ ἡμέτερον
γένος εὐφραίνεται διὰ τὸν ἀναστάντα. Βοᾷ γὰρ ἡ σήμερον ἡμέρα τῇ ἐγέρσει μου καὶ
λέγει· «Ἐν τῷ ἐμῷ δρόμῳ εἶδον θέαμα καινόν, μνημεῖον ἀνοιγόμενον καὶ ἄνθρωπον
1
ἐγειρόμενον καὶ ὀστέα ἀγαλλιώμενα καὶ ψυχὰς χαιρομένας καὶ ἀνθρώπους
πλασσομένους καὶ οὐρανοὺς σχιζομένους καὶ δυνάμεις κραζούσας· "Αρατε πύλας οἱ
ἄρχοντες ὑμῶν" καὶ τὰ ἑξῆς. Σήμερον εἶδον τὸν ἐπουράνιον βασιλέα ἀναβαίνοντα,
περιεζωσμένον φῶς, ὑπὲρ ἀστραπὴν καὶ ἀκτῖνας, ὑπὲρ ἥλιον καὶ πηγὰς ὑδάτων,
ὑπὲρ νεφέλας καὶ πνεῦμα δυνάμεως καὶ ζωὴν αἰώνιον.»
thought_title: Copying the Thief and Hearing the Day Shout Victory
orientation: Hesychius is preaching to the congregation, turning from the cross to urge them to share the good thief's prayer and to hear this Easter festival as victory.
pass_a_gloss: Let us imitate the good intention of the killer, but rather of the one bearing the Spirit because of the faith after these things. For what indeed does he say? "Remember me, lord, in your kingdom." And by one assent of faith he dwells in paradise and flies about through the heavens. "For amen I say to you, he says, today you will be with me in paradise." Let us also remain beside the cross of the savior, saying the same utterances: "Lord, remember me in your kingdom," in order that we also may become sharers of paradise and may enjoy kingdom of heavens. The present festival is a victory celebration, brothers, a victory celebration of the son of God who is king of all. For today the devil was defeated because of the one crucified, and our race rejoices because of the one who rose. For the day that is today shouts at my awakening and says: "In my course I saw a new sight, a tomb opened and a man raised and bones exulting and souls rejoicing and men formed and heavens split and powers crying: 'Lift up the gates, you rulers of yours' and the rest. Today I saw the heavenly king going up, clothed around with light, beyond lightning and rays, beyond sun and springs of waters, beyond cloud and breath of power and eternal life."

choices.why: keeps the harsh literal contrast from murderer to inspired believer without importing thief as title
keeps the single act that gives immediate dwelling in paradise
uses victory sense from brief and plain phrase for the compound title

choices.english: Lift up the gates, you rulers of yours
choices.why: keeps imperative and odd possessive exactly as quoted cry of the powers

bible_refs.note: Μνήσθητί μου, κύριε, ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ σου
Ἀμὴν λέγω σοι, σήμερον μετ᾽ ἐμοῦ ἔσῃ ἐν τῷ παραδείσῳ

pass_b_english: Let us imitate the good resolve of the killer, or rather of the one bearing the Spirit because of the faith that followed. For what does he say? "Remember me, Lord, in your Kingdom" (Luke 23:42). By one assent of faith he dwells in paradise and ranges through the heavens. For Christ answers him, "Truly I tell you, today you will be with me in paradise" (Luke 23:43). Let us also stay by the cross of the Savior, speaking those same words, "Lord, remember me in your Kingdom" (Luke 23:42), so that we too may share in paradise and enjoy the Kingdom of heaven.

This present festival, brothers, is a victory celebration, a victory celebration of the Son of God, the King of all. For today through the one who was crucified the devil has been defeated, and through the one who rose our race rejoices.

For today itself cries out at my resurrection and says, "In my course I saw a new sight: a tomb opened and a man rising and bones exulting and souls rejoicing and human beings formed anew and the heavens split and the powers crying, 'Lift up your gates, you rulers' (Psalm 24:7 (LXX 23:7)), and the rest. Today I saw the heavenly King ascending, wrapped in light, beyond lightning and rays, beyond sun and springs of water, beyond cloud and spirit of power and eternal life."
notes: stray 1 in source line appears to be a page or line number, not translated
τῇ ἐγέρσει μου is uncertain; glossed as at my awakening

problems.quote: Lift up the gates, you rulers of yours
problems.why: 'You rulers of yours' is garbled English that misrenders the LXX Psalm 23:7 idiom (where ὑμῶν gives 'your gates' or 'your rulers').
problems.fix: Lift up your gates, you rulers
problems.ruling: ὑμῶν goes with πύλας ('your gates'), not ἄρχοντες; 'rulers of yours' is garbled and misstates the psalm line.

edits.old: Lift up the gates, you rulers of yours
edits.new: Lift up your gates, you rulers

fixed: Fixed `Lift up the gates, you rulers of yours' to `Lift up your gates, you rulers': source ἄρατε πύλας οἱ άρχοντες ὑμῶν (LXX Ps 23:7) has ὑμῶν with πύλας, i.e. `your gates'.
